description: This Java source file defines the PaymentsController class, which is a Spring MVC controller responsible for managing payment methods in an admin web interface of an e-commerce platform. It handles requests related to displaying, configuring, saving, and deleting payment module configurations, and integrates with the PaymentService to perform these operations.

classes.name: PaymentsController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller for managing payment methods in the admin interface, including viewing, editing, saving, and deleting payment configurations.

methods.name: getPaymentMethods
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the list of available payment methods and their configurations for a specific merchant store.

methods.name: displayPaymentMethod
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the configuration page for a specific payment method identified by its code.

methods.name: savePaymentMethod
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save or update the configuration for a specific payment method.

methods.name: deletePaymentMethod
methods.description: Handles POST requests to delete the configuration of a specific payment method.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets up the menu context and active menu items for the web interface.
